description: Scientific publications (articles, theses, conference papers). One document is one publication.

acknowledgments.description: Contains acknowledgment-related information for the publication.
Full text of acknowledgments as written in the publication.

lang.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) of the acknowledgments text.

acronym.description: Acronym variations of the affiliation in multiple languages.

default.description: Default acronym of the affiliation if no language-specific version exists.

encoded_key.description: Internal encoded key for the affiliation, used for deduplication or reference.

id.description: PID of an affiliation. Can be the only field of the object if this affiliation is not mapped in the organization index.Otherwise, if present, some fields are denormalized: `mainAddress`, `label`, `acronym`, `kind`, `level`, `status`, `isFrench`, `id_name`. See the documention of the organization index for more details on these fields.

id_name.description: Human-readable name of the affiliation derived from its PID.

id_name_default.description: Default name of the affiliation, used when no language-specific label is available.

isFrench.description: Indicates whether the affiliation is based in France (true/false).

is_main_parent.description: Boolean flag (0/1) indicating if this affiliation is the primary parent organization.

kind.description: Classification of the affiliation (e.g., university, research institute, company).

label.description: Multilingual labels for the affiliation's name, keyed by language code.

default.description: Default name of the affiliation when no language-specific label is available.

en.description: English name of the affiliation, if available.

fr.description: French name of the affiliation, if available.

level.description: Hierarchical level of the affiliation (e.g., department, faculty, institution).

mainAddress.description: Primary address details for the affiliation, including city and country.

address_detected.description: Raw detected address string for the affiliation’s main location, unnormalized.

city.description: City where the affiliation's main address is located.

country.description: Country where the affiliation's main address is located.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the affiliation’s main address.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the affiliation’s main address.

region.description: Administrative region (e.g., state/province) of the affiliation’s main address.

status.description: Current operational status of the affiliation (e.g., active, closed).

typologie_1.description: Primary classification type for the affiliation (e.g., 'University', 'Company').

typologie_2.description: Secondary classification type for the affiliation, refining `typologie_1`.

BNF.description: Bibliothèque Nationale de France identifier for the author's affiliation.

ISNI.description: International Standard Name Identifier for the author's affiliation.

acronym.description: Short form or abbreviation of the author's affiliation name.

address.description: Full formatted address of the author's affiliation.

address-line.description: Individual line of the author's affiliation address (e.g., street, city).

addresses.description: Full address text of the author's affiliation, as extracted from the source.

alias_idref.description: Alternative identifier for the affiliation from the IdRef authority database.

aliases.description: List of alternative names or variants for the affiliation.

city.description: City where the author's affiliation is located, as extracted from the address.

comments.description: Human or machine-generated notes about the affiliation's extraction or disambiguation.

country.description: Country where the author's affiliation is located, as extracted from the address.

datasource.description: Source of the raw affiliation string

department.description: Specific department, lab, or sub-unit within the author's affiliation.

detected_countries.description: List of countries detected in the affiliation string, including potential false positives.

docid.description: Internal document identifier linking the affiliation to its source record.

ed.description: Education or institutional designation (e.g., 'PhD program') associated with the affiliation.

external_ids.description: External identifiers for the affiliation, keyed by identifier type.

id_type.description: Type of the external identifier (e.g., GRID, ROR, ISNI).

id_value.description: Value of the external identifier for the affiliation.

grid.description: GRID identifier for the affiliation, if available.

hal_docid.description: HAL document identifier for the affiliation, if applicable.

id.description: Reference to the organization in the scanr-organizations index.

asserted-by.description: Indicates which system asserted the affiliation ID (e.g., publisher, author).

id.description: Unique identifier for the affiliation in the referenced system.

id-type.description: Type of the identifier (e.g., RNSR, GRID, ROR).

id_name_author_labo.description: Normalized name of the affiliation as used by the author in the publication.

idref.description: IdRef identifier for the author's affiliation, used for disambiguation and linking.

source.description: Source of the affiliation identifier (e.g., 'RNSR', 'ROR') in the `ids` object.

ids.description: List of automatic match PIDS (object with field `id` and `type`)

orgs.description: Normalized organization details extracted from the raw affiliation string.

name.description: Name of the organization as extracted from the raw affiliation string.

place.description: Geographic location or city associated with the author's affiliation.

postal-code.description: Postal code associated with the author's affiliation, if available.

rnsr.description: RNSR identifier for the author's affiliation, used for French research organizations.

ror.description: ROR identifier for the author's affiliation, used for global research organizations.

structId.description: Internal structure identifier for the author's affiliation, if applicable.

toIdentify2.description: Raw affiliation string flagged for manual identification or disambiguation.

viaf.description: VIAF identifier for the author's affiliation, linking to the Virtual International Authority File.

websites.description: Websites associated with the author's affiliation, typically institutional URLs.

zipcode.description: Postal zip code of the author's affiliation, aiding in geographic identification.

affiliations.description: List of objects object describing the authors's affiliations

awards.description: Object containing awards or honors associated with the author.

date.description: Date when the author received the award, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Human-readable name or title of the award given to the author.

structure.description: Name of the organization or body that granted the award to the author.

url.description: URL linking to details about the award or its granting institution.

denormalized.description: PID of the author (`id` (with idref prefix), `id_hal`, `orcid`)

id.description: Unique internal identifier for the denormalized author record.

id_hal.description: HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne) identifier for the author, if available.

idref.description: IdRef identifier for the author, linking to the French authority database.

orcid.description: ORCID identifier for the author, ensuring unique global identification.

id_name.description: Concatenation of the `id` and `fullName` separated by `###`.

person.description: Reference to the author's detailed record in the scanr-persons index.

role.description: Role of the contributor. Default value is `author`. A different value only if present in source (theses.fr or HAL).

tags.description: Tags or keywords associated with the author, often for classification.

toIdentify.description: Flag indicating if the author's identity requires further verification.

autocompleted.description: array of strings used for autocompletion

autocompletedJournal.description: Normalized journal name for search autocompletion and display.

autocompletedPublisher.description: Normalized publisher name for search autocompletion and display.

bso_local_affiliations.description: Affiliations identified by the BSO (Bibliometric System for Organizations) algorithm.

cited_by_counts_by_year.description: Annual citation counts for the publication, keyed by year.

2012.description: Number of times the publication was cited in 2012.

2013.description: Number of times the publication was cited in 2013.

2014.description: Number of times the publication was cited in 2014.

2015.description: Number of times the publication was cited in 2015.

2016.description: Number of times the publication was cited in 2016.

2017.description: Number of times the publication was cited in 2017.

2018.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2018.

2019.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2019.

2020.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2020.

2021.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2021.

2022.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2022.

2023.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2023.

2024.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2024.

2025.description: Number of citations received by the publication in 2025.

co_authors.description: List of co-authors associated with the publication.

co_countries.description: List of countries represented by the publication's co-authors.

co_domains.description: Broad scientific domains associated with collaborating entities in the publication.

co_institutions.description: Institutions that collaborated on the publication, listed as free text.

co_projects.description: Names of collaborative projects associated with the publication.

co_software.description: Software tools or platforms mentioned in collaboration contexts for the publication.

co_structures.description: Organizational structures (e.g., labs, departments) involved in the publication.

doiUrl.description: Resolvable URL for the publication's DOI, enabling direct access to the record.

code.description: Code ID of this domain, if any (depends on `type`)

count.description: Number of times this code has been detected within the title, abstract and keywords.

id_name.description: Concatenation of code and label, separated by `##`

key_name.description: Machine-readable key for the scientific domain (e.g., 'cs.AI' for Computer Science).

label.description: Human-readable name of the scientific domain in multiple languages.

naturalKey.description: Normalized version of the label string (no accent, no space ...)

type.description: Type of label. Possible values: `wikidata`, `keyword`, `sudoc`. Wikidata domains are automatically detected within the title, abstract and keywords. Keywords domain are exactly the free-text keywords that have been harvested (not normalized).
`nnt` (for French thesis, 'nnt' stands for 'Numéro National de Thèse'), `doi` (Digital Object Identifier), `hal` (if present in HAL) or 'pmid' (if present in PubMed)

id.description: Main PID of the production. This id is a concatenation of the id type (e.g `doi` and the id itself).

institutions.description: Denormalized metadata about institutions linked to the publication.

acronym.description: Acronyms associated with the institution, available in multiple languages.

default.description: Primary or default acronym of the institution if no language preference is specified.

encoded_key.description: Unique internal identifier for the institution, used for system references.

id.description: Persistent identifier for the institution, typically a ROR or GRID ID.

id_name.description: Normalized name of the institution, used for display and search.

id_name_default.description: Default display name for the institution when no language preference is specified.

isFrench.description: Indicates whether the institution is based in France (true) or not (false).

is_main_parent.description: Flag marking the institution as the primary parent in a hierarchical structure (1=true, 0=false).

kind.description: Categorizes the institution type (e.g., university, research institute, company).

label.description: Multilingual labels for the institution, keyed by language code.

default.description: Default institution name when no language-specific label is available.

level.description: Hierarchical level of the institution (e.g., university, faculty, department).

mainAddress.description: Primary address details of the institution, including city, country, and region.

city.description: Name of the city where the institution's main address is located.

country.description: Name of the country where the institution's main address is located.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the institution's main address.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the institution's main address.

region.description: Administrative region (e.g., state, province) of the institution's main address.

status.description: Current operational status of the institution (e.g., active, closed, merged).

typologie_1.description: Broad classification of the institution (e.g., public, private, research).

typologie_2.description: Detailed classification of the institution (e.g., engineering school, medical school).

isOa.description: Is Open Access? Computed with Unpaywall data if DOI crossref, with HAL and theses.fr otherwise.

ix.description: Internal index identifier for the publication, used for sorting or pagination.

keywords.description: Author-provided or extracted keywords describing the publication's topics.

default.description: List of string. Keywords (not normalized) chosen by the authors. These keywords are also present in the `domains` with type=`keyword`.

oaEvidence.description: Describes the open access version (if any)

hostType.description: Only one hostType is given, with a priority to the publisher, just like in the Unpaywall data. More complete data on open access routes can be found in the French Open Science Monitor data (Baromètre de la Science Ouverte).

license.description: Open Access license (from Unpaywall data or HAL)

url.description: Open Access URL (from Unpaywall data or HAL)

pdfUrl.description: URL pointing to the full-text PDF of the publication, if available.

predict_teds.description: Predicted TED (Technology, Engineering, Design) categories for the publication.

probability.description: Confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) for the predicted TED category label.

productionType.description: String for type of production. Possible values: `publications`, `thesis`.

project.description: Metadata about the primary research project associated with the publication.

label.description: Localized labels for the primary research project.

default.description: Default label for the primary research project in the publication's primary language.

projects.description: Metadata about all research projects associated with the publication.

acronym.description: Localized acronyms for a research project in the `projects` object.

default.description: Default acronym for a research project in the publication's primary language.

id.description: Unique identifier for a research project associated with the publication.

id_name.description: Normalized identifier combining project ID and name for consistent referencing.

label.description: Localized labels for the project, structured by language codes.

default.description: Default label of the project associated with the publication.

en.description: English label for the project, used for display and filtering.

fr.description: French label for the project, used for display and filtering.

year.description: Year the project was initiated or funded, for temporal filtering.

publicationDate.description: Formatted as YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00. When available, the `published_date` from Unpaywall is used. When not avaiable (no DOI Crossref), if data comes from HAL, these fields from HAL are used, in this priority order: `publicationDate_s`, `ePublicationDate_s`, `defenseDate_s`, `producedDate_s`.

software.description: Metadata about software mentioned or used in the publication.

contexts.description: Describes the role or usage of the software in the publication (e.g., 'data analysis', 'simulation').

id_name.description: Human-readable name of the software, derived from its identifier.

softwareName.description: Name of the software mentioned in the publication.

wikidata.description: Wikidata identifier for the software, enabling cross-referencing.

source.description: Describes the source (generally journal) of the production

isInDoaj.description: Indicates if the publication's source journal is listed in the DOAJ.

isOa.description: Is it an open access journal? (source Unpaywall)

structured_acknowledgments.description: Structured data for acknowledgments, including funders and infrastructures.

funders.description: Details about funding organizations acknowledged in the publication.

entity.description: Name or identifier of the funding entity (e.g., agency, institution).

grant_id.description: Grant or award identifier associated with the funding.

program.description: Program or initiative under which the funding was awarded.

infrastructures.description: Details about research infrastructures (e.g., facilities, equipment) acknowledged.

entity.description: Name or identifier of the infrastructure acknowledged in the publication.

grant_id.description: Grant or funding ID associated with the acknowledged infrastructure.

program.description: Program name under which the infrastructure was funded or operated.

type.description: Category or classification of the acknowledged infrastructure (e.g., 'research facility').

private_companies.description: Details of private companies acknowledged for contributions to the publication.

entity.description: Name or identifier of the private company acknowledged in the publication.

grant_id.description: Grant or funding ID associated with the acknowledged private company.

program.description: Program name under which the private company's contribution was funded.

type.description: Category or classification of the acknowledged private company (e.g., 'sponsor').

publication_id.description: Unique identifier linking acknowledgments to the publication record.

raw_md.description: Markdown-formatted raw acknowledgments text as extracted from the source.

text.description: Plain-text version of acknowledgments, normalized for readability.

structures.description: Contains metadata about research structures linked to the publication.

acronym.description: Acronyms of the structure in multiple languages.

default.description: Default acronym of the structure when no language preference is specified.

fr.description: French acronym of the structure, if available.

encoded_key.description: Unique encoded key identifying the structure in external systems.

id_name.description: Human-readable identifier of the structure, combining ID and name.

id_name_default.description: Default human-readable identifier when no language preference is specified.

isFrench.description: Indicates whether the structure is based in France (true/false).

kind.description: Type of the research structure (e.g., laboratory, department, institute).

label.description: Localized name of the research structure in multiple languages.

default.description: Default name of the research structure in its primary language.

fr.description: French name of the research structure, if available.

level.description: Hierarchical level of the structure (e.g., UMR, UPR, EA).

mainAddress.description: Primary address details of the research structure.

address_detected.description: Raw address string as detected from the source data.

city.description: City where the research structure is primarily located.

region.description: Region or administrative division of the structure's main address.

status.description: Current operational status of the research structure (e.g., active, closed).

typologie_1.description: Primary classification of the research structure, e.g., 'UMR', 'UAR', 'LabEx'.

typologie_2.description: Secondary classification of the research structure, e.g., 'FRE', 'FR', 'GIS'.

default.description: Default language summary of the publication’s key points and findings.

en.description: English-language summary of the publication’s key points and findings.

fr.description: French-language summary of the publication’s key points and findings.

summary.description: summary / abstract by language (with `default` only if unknown)

tags.description: Categorized metadata tags associated with the publication.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tag, used for cross-referencing or filtering.

label.description: Human-readable label for the tag, localized by language.

default.description: Default language display label for the tag.

en.description: English-language display label for the tag.

fr.description: French label of a tag associated with the publication.

title.description: Container for multilingual versions of the publication's title.

default.description: Default or fallback title of the publication if no language-specific version exists.

en.description: English version of the publication's title, if available.

fr.description: French version of the publication's title, if available.

title_abs_text.description: Abstract text extracted from the publication, often used for full-text search.

topics.description: Container for hierarchical topic classifications associated with the publication.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the topic, used for display or filtering.

domain.description: Container for domain-specific metadata within a topic classification.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the topic's domain, used for display or filtering.

id.description: Unique identifier for the scientific domain associated with a topic.

field.description: Object containing details about the scientific field related to a topic.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the scientific field for display purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the scientific field associated with a topic.
Unique identifier for a topic extracted from the publication.

score.description: Confidence score (0-1) indicating relevance of the topic to the publication.

subfield.description: Object containing details about the scientific subfield related to a topic.

display_name.description: Human-readable name of the scientific subfield for display purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the scientific subfield associated with a topic.

year.description: Year part of the publication Date
